author: SkipTheBekfist
body:
My IGN: RexNicky
Banned For:Fly/Speed Hacks
Why I should be unbanned: Well I have no clue why I was hacking.  I was in a call with friends and I just lost control.  I know hacking is wrong and will never do it again!

Ok I lied on my post before.  I feel really bad.  I was hacking.
I has no evidence.
Honestly I don't know if I have waited long enough.  If i could get like unbanned but have to wait I would do it.
I dont have an alt.  I have not ban evaded.
I have had one appeal before.


Side Note:  I will do just about anything to get unbanned.  I used to play with friends on here a lot.  Me hacking ruined it for us.  


~RexNicky

Thanks,
